name: hero-section
title: Hero Section
description: Landing hero with an eyebrow pill, headline, copy, two calls to action and an optional media slot, revealed in a soft stagger.

props.name: title
props.description: The headline. Labels the section for assistive tech.

props.name: rotatingWords
props.description: Words that take turns after the headline. Uses Word Rotate, installed with the block.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Small pill above the headline, e.g. "New · v1.0".

props.name: primaryAction
props.type: { label: ReactNode; href?: string; onClick?: () => void }
props.description: Filled call to action. A link when href is set, a button otherwise.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.type: { label: ReactNode; href?: string; onClick?: () => void }
props.description: Outlined call to action next to the primary one.

props.name: media
props.description: Image, video or mock-up. Beside the copy when align is 'left', below it when 'center'.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds each piece takes to fade in.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
